notes.title: I thought this was a roguelite? Rework Update 1/3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Working on some heavy reworks to the game feel and story mode systems, trying to address the feedback of players and make the game clearer, for now I enabled the High Score / Endless Mode and Story Mode will be disabled as I rework these systems.

Update 2/3 (Coming soon)

-Tutorials
-Passives
-Unlockables
-Story Mode Reenabled
